meta.name: KPI Mobile - Emerald Data System
meta.description: Design DNA untuk aplikasi mobile Sistem KPI Toko HP (Flutter Material 3). Diekstrak dari AppTheme tokens + implementasi layar yang sudah di-refresh (WCAG AA, emerald primary, data-dense dashboard).

primary.role: Brand + primary CTA (Emerald 700, WCAG 5.48:1 vs putih)

secondary.role: Accent lime — signature highlight (badge PERIODE AKTIF, CTA)

neutral.usage: Background slate-50, card white, parchment F5F5EB untuk info boxes, border E2E8F0, teks ink 14140F, muted 6E6E64, dark gradient 1E293B→0F172A untuk hero/period card

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast — primary gelap (5.48:1), teks ink gelap di bg terang, status colors diuji terpisah

typography.font_style_notes: Sans-serif humanist, pakai font platform native (hapus Inter yang tidak ter-bundle). Hierarki via weight (800/700/600) + size, bukan warna.

spacing.section_rhythm: 16-24px antar section, 12px antar elemen dalam card, 8dp rhythm konsisten

layout.grid_system: Single column mobile, full-width cards, 20px horizontal padding (16px di list)
layout.alignment_tendency: left-aligned content, cards full width, metric cards equal 3-column

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px border pada cards (E2E8F0), tanpa border tebal
shape.divider_style: hairline 1px border, divider height 20 di detail rows

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused — elevation 0 di cards (pakai border), shadow ringan di hero card & FAB
elevation.depth_cues: overlapping layers + color intensity (gradient dark card) + border

iconography.style: Material Icons rounded (filled/outline mixed, konsisten per hierarchy)

motion.entrance_pattern: fade + subtle grow (progress bar AnimatedContainer), ease-out
motion.philosophy: minimal functional — animasi hanya untuk menyampaikan perubahan state (progress), respect reduced-motion

components.button_style: Full-width 50px, radius 12, bg primary emerald, teks putih bold 15px, disabled alpha 0.5, pressed = primaryPressed 065F46
components.input_style: Filled white, radius 12, border E2E8F0, focused border primary 2px, content padding 16/14
components.card_style: White, radius 16, border 1px E2E8F0, elevation 0, padding 16-18
components.navigation_pattern: Bottom nav <=5 item (fixed), overflow PopupMenuButton di AppBar untuk item sekunder
components.modal_style: AlertDialog standar, radius 16 (theme default), scrim default
components.list_style: Card list dengan margin bottom 12, InkWell tap, rounded 16
components.component_notes: Status chips: pill dengan bg color alpha 0.12 + teks warna status. Metric cards: 3 kolom equal, value 20px w800 + label 12px muted.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: health check / vital signs — hijau = sehat & berkembang

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (gradient hero card, lime badge)
visual_language.whitespace_usage: comfortable — 20px page padding, 16px card padding, breathing room antar section
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: balanced — header card berat (dark gradient) sebagai anchor, sisanya ringan
visual_language.focal_strategy: distributed interest — satu hero (period card) + KPI cards sebagai secondary focal
visual_language.texture_usage: none (flat + gradient hanya di hero & progress)

composition.grouping_strategy: card-based grouping per section, section title di atas

imagery.graphic_elements: gradient hero card, progress bars, status chips, avatar circle

interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: low-moderate — hanya state changes, tidak dekoratif

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: icon + pesan + action retry (Coba Lagi / Muat Ulang)

overview.performance_tier: lightweight (native Flutter animations, no third-party lib)

background_effects.description: Hero/period card pakai LinearGradient 1E293B→0F172A; login brand icon gradient primary→059669

visual_effects.composite_notes: Design sengaja minimal-effek: native Flutter animation saja (AnimatedContainer untuk progress 250ms ease-out, InkRipple press feedback, RefreshIndicator pull-to-refresh). Tidak ada WebGL/Canvas/particle — cocok untuk app internal yang butuh performa & aksesibilitas. Reduced-motion dihormati via MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf → Duration.zero.
